In plain English

Overnight the pound slid from 1.31161 to 1.30774, below the Asia low and below last week's low 1.30798. The dollar did the opposite and rose into a 4-hour area where sellers stepped in before.

London often opens by pushing one more time in the overnight direction, then turns. We wait for that last push down to fail: a 5-minute candle closing back above 1.30797. If the pound closes below 1.30540 instead, we stand aside.
